title: Data Breach Announcements and Stock Market Reactions: A Matter of Timing?
eligible_reason: Study 1 is a daily time-series IV regression (log breach announcements on news pressure instrumented by earnings announcements, Tables 3-7); Study 2 is a finance event study of cumulative abnormal returns regressed on continuous news pressure (Tables 8-11). No binary staggered treatment with unit and time FE.
design_notes: do.do: ivregress 2sls log_breaches (news_pressure = log_earns) i.dow i.week i.month i.year wsj_columnchange, r cluster(my) (Table 3); reg car_mm_3_5 news_pressure $controls, vce(cluster yq) (Tables 9-10).
data_files_note: readme.docx: data under NDA, shared under MS policy 4a with firm and date identifiers disguised.
data_provenance_note: Firm and date identifiers disguised by the authors; outcome values appear real. Moot (design ineligible).
screener_notes: Published PDF text read; 'event study' refers to stock-market CAR event studies, not DiD.
